```

```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

```
className="font-medium text-s-accent transition-opacity hover:opacity-80"
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `app/[locale]/behandlungen/[...slug]/TreatmentsClient.tsx:172` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
{pageTitle || "Behandlungen"}<span className="text-s-accent">.</span>
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `app/[locale]/dashboard/calendar/page.tsx:1077` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```

```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

```
? "bg-s-accent"
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx:202` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-s-ink-2"><span className="w-[9px] h-[9px] rounded-[3px] bg-s-accent-bright" />{t("revenue")}</span>
```

### `app/[locale]/dashboard/settings/page.tsx:1147` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
{method === opt.id && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-s-accent-bright" />}
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `app/[locale]/discover/page.tsx:419` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
<span className="absolute right-1 top-1 z-20 flex h-[15px] w-[15px] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-s-accent text-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-white/60">
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `app/globals.css:177` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
Single-point rule so every existing text-s-accent link/button gets the step
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

```

```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `components-legacy/booking/BookingConfirmation.tsx:298` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 font-semibold text-s-accent transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

```
<Grid3X3 size={16} className="text-s-accent" />
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

### `components-legacy/home/TrustStatsBanner.tsx:58` — **INFO A9: blue on possibly-non-interactive text (v2)**

```
<p className="font-body text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.22em] text-s-accent mb-3 text-center">
```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._


_Per LOCKFILE §2.5 rule A13 (card text hierarchy, V3-D346): font-bold (700) is reserved for Hero H1. Card/list-item names use font-medium (500) as the single ink anchor; meta uses font-normal text-s-ink-2. Drop font-bold -> font-medium (if this is the name) or font-normal text-s-ink-2 (if this is meta). Or use the <CardName>/<CardMeta> primitives._

```

```

_Design Language v2 (CANON §0): blue `s-accent` = INTERACTIVITY — CORRECT on links / see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / tappable rows / inline action labels (those are whitelisted). WRONG only on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — or as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._

If this line is a real tappable affordance, it's fine; if it's static text, swap to ink._
